claims: The 2026 NBA Playoffs begin on April 18, 2026.
The 2026 NBA Finals are scheduled to begin on June 3, 2026.
The 2026 NBA Play-In Tournament concluded on April 17, 2026.
The Phoenix Suns secured the final Western Conference seed in the 2026 NBA Play-In Tournament.
The Orlando Magic secured the final Eastern Conference seed in the 2026 NBA Play-In Tournament.
The first round of the 2026 NBA Playoffs starts on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
The 2026 NBA Finals start on Wednesday, June 3, 2026.
2026 NBA playoff games are available on NBA.com, ESPN, and TNT.
Fans can participate in the 2026 NBA Pick'Em Bracket Challenge.
This information is based on results available as of April 18, 2026.
